description: UplyTech is a community and project for development, design, video and marketing. It is not a registered business. I build websites, web apps, APIs and custom software there, and I host and maintain what I ship. The GitHub organisation followed in March 2024.
Founded the esports club in April 2025 and handed it over to a community member in September 2026.
Wrote the marketing plan and ran social media.
Built a merch shop and a tournament planner with React, Socket.IO, Node.js and Express. The shop has since closed.
Member of an Austrian development team. In mid-2018 I wrote their SGID system, a Vue.js web system with its API.
A Minecraft network with every game mode on one server, its own plugins, a shop and a TeamSpeak server. This is where I taught myself to code.
